def test_r5_segmented_pixels_are_cluster_centroids(tmp_path):
    p = tmp_path / "img.png"
    original = _make_image(p)
    _, seg = task_func(str(p), n_clusters=3)
    flat_orig = original.reshape(-1, 3).astype(np.float64)
    flat_seg = seg.reshape(-1, 3).astype(np.float64)
    centroids = np.unique(flat_seg, axis=0)
    # every segmented pixel must be one of the centroid colors
    for px in flat_seg[::37]:
        assert np.any(np.all(np.isclose(centroids, px), axis=1))
    # each centroid should be close to the mean of the original pixels
    # assigned to it (within rounding tolerance)
    for c in centroids:
        mask = np.all(np.isclose(flat_seg, c), axis=1)
        assert mask.sum() > 0
        mean = flat_orig[mask].mean(axis=0)
        assert np.all(np.abs(mean - c) <= 2.0)
